events.title: BAE Systems MK 41 VLS canister production contract modification
events.summary: BAE Systems Land & Armaments received a $169.22 million modification exercising options for production of MK 41 Vertical Launching System canisters and ancillary equipment for the United States and FMS customers Australia, Japan and the Netherlands.

programs.program_name_raw: MK 41 Vertical Launching System canister and ancillary equipment

action.description: Exercise contract options for MK 41 VLS canister and ancillary equipment production for U.S. and FMS requirements.
action.description_zh: 執行既有合約選擇權，生產 MK 41 垂直發射系統發射筒及相關附屬設備，供美軍及澳洲、日本、荷蘭等 FMS 客戶使用。

events.title_zh: BAE Systems 獲 1.692 億美元 MK 41 VLS 發射筒增購合約
events.summary_zh: BAE Systems Land & Armaments 獲得 1.692 億美元固定價格合約修改，執行 MK 41 垂直發射系統發射筒及附屬設備的生產選擇權。採購分配為美國 53%、澳洲 23%、日本 13%、荷蘭 11%，其中後三者透過 FMS 執行，預計 2031 年 4 月完成。對應上市母公司為 BAE Systems，LSE ticker：BA.。
events.source_text_original: Official contract text is available at the linked War.gov source.

events.title: Lockheed Martin F-35 Lot 18-19 pilot flight equipment order
events.summary: Lockheed Martin Aeronautics received a $29.6 million order for F-35 pilot flight equipment supporting Lot 18-19 deliveries, operational aircraft, FMS customers and international program participants.

programs.name_zh: F-35 Lightning II 聯合攻擊戰鬥機

contractor.name: Lockheed Martin
contractor.name_raw: Lockheed Martin Corp., Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Co.

action.description: Procure pilot flight equipment for F-35 Lot 18-19 deliveries and operational aircraft across U.S. services and international customers.
action.description_zh: 採購 F-35 Lot 18-19 新交付及現役機隊所需飛行員飛行裝備，涵蓋美國空軍、海軍陸戰隊、海軍、FMS 客戶及其他國際計畫參與國。

events.title_zh: Lockheed Martin 獲 2,960 萬美元 F-35 飛行員裝備訂單
events.summary_zh: Lockheed Martin Aeronautics 獲得 2,960 萬美元訂單，採購 F-35 Lot 18-19 交付批次與現役機隊使用的飛行員飛行裝備，涵蓋美國空軍、海軍陸戰隊、海軍，以及 FMS 與非美國國防部計畫參與者。預計 2029 年 7 月完成。廠商 ticker：LMT（NYSE）。
events.source_text_original: Official contract text is available at the linked War.gov source.

events.title: General Dynamics Mission Systems shipset systems development and production modification
events.summary: General Dynamics Mission Systems received a $15.63 million modification for shipset production, engineering and installation support covering software and hardware systems development, production and platform installation.

programs.program_name_raw: shipset production, engineering, and installation support

contractor.name: General Dynamics Mission Systems
contractor.name_raw: General Dynamics Mission Systems, Manassas, Virginia

action.description: Exercise options for shipset production plus engineering and installation support for software and hardware system development, production and platform installations.
action.description_zh: 執行合約選擇權，進行艦載系統套件生產，並提供軟硬體系統開發、生產、工程及平台安裝支援。

issues: Official contract notice does not identify the specific platform or named weapon program.

events.title_zh: General Dynamics Mission Systems 獲 1,563 萬美元艦載系統生產與整合合約修改
events.summary_zh: General Dynamics Mission Systems 獲得 1,563 萬美元合約修改，執行艦載系統套件生產、工程與安裝支援，包括軟體與硬體系統開發、生產及平台安裝。預計 2027 年 8 月完成。其上市母公司為 General Dynamics，ticker：GD（NYSE）。
events.source_text_original: Official contract text is available at the linked War.gov source.

events.agency: Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division
events.title: Overland AI Autonomous Breaching Capability development contract
events.summary: Overland AI received a $14.31 million SBIR Phase II contract to integrate and test modular formation-based autonomy on six heavy commercial trucks for combat engineer autonomous breaching operations, including MICLIC, mine roller, lane marking and counter-UAS payloads.

action.description: Develop, integrate and test modular formation-based autonomous driving and mission payload capability on six heavy-duty commercial trucks for combat engineer breaching missions.
action.description_zh: 在 6 輛商用重型卡車上整合成熟自主駕駛技術，開發、整合並測試編隊式任務自主能力，用於戰鬥工兵越野自主破障；任務模組包括 M58 MICLIC、商規滾輪式掃雷器、車道標記系統及反無人機系統。

events.title_zh: Overland AI 獲 1,431 萬美元自主破障系統開發合約
events.summary_zh: Overland AI 獲得 1,431 萬美元 SBIR Phase II 合約，在 6 輛重型商用卡車上整合自主駕駛與編隊任務能力，支援戰鬥工兵自主破障。系統將整合 M58 MICLIC 掃雷爆破索、掃雷滾輪、車道標記與反無人機任務模組，預計 2027 年 10 月完成。Overland AI 為私人公司，無公開 ticker。
events.source_text_original: Official contract text is available at the linked War.gov source.

events.title: University of Connecticut undersea vehicle technology research contract
events.summary: The University of Connecticut received a $13.62 million research contract through the National Institute for Undersea Vehicle Technology partnership with the University of Rhode Island to advance acoustics, sensors, materials, propulsion, systems engineering and underwater energy technologies.

programs.canonical_name: National Institute for Undersea Vehicle Technology
programs.name_zh: 國家水下載具技術研究院計畫

action.description: Conduct applied research advancing undersea vehicle technologies including acoustics, sensing, signal processing, materials, structures, propulsion, systems engineering and underwater energy systems.
action.description_zh: 透過 UConn 與 URI 的 NIUVT 合作進行水下載具應用研究，涵蓋聲學、感測器與訊號處理、先進材料與結構、人因、推進技術、系統工程及水下能源系統。

events.title_zh: 康乃狄克大學獲 1,362 萬美元水下載具技術研究合約
events.summary_zh: 康乃狄克大學獲美國海軍研究辦公室 1,362 萬美元研究合約，與羅德島大學透過 NIUVT 推進水下載具技術，研究範圍包含聲學、感測與訊號處理、先進材料、推進、水下能源及系統工程，預計持續至 2031 年 8 月。此承包單位為大學，無公開 ticker。
events.source_text_original: Official contract text is available at the linked War.gov source.

events.title: Nikira Labs submarine spectroscopic total air monitor development and production modification
events.summary: Nikira Labs received a $12.92 million modification for continued development, production and installation of spectroscopic total air monitoring equipment on U.S. Navy submarines.

programs.program_name_raw: spectroscopic total air monitor on U.S. Navy submarines
programs.name_zh: 潛艦光譜式總空氣監測系統

action.description: Continue development, production and installation of spectroscopic total air monitoring systems aboard U.S. Navy submarines.
action.description_zh: 持續開發、生產並在美國海軍潛艦上安裝光譜式總空氣監測系統。

events.title_zh: Nikira Labs 獲 1,292 萬美元美軍潛艦空氣監測系統合約修改
events.summary_zh: Nikira Labs 獲得 1,292 萬美元合約修改，用於持續開發、生產與安裝美國海軍潛艦的光譜式總空氣監測系統，預計 2030 年 4 月完成。Nikira Labs 為私人公司，無公開 ticker。
events.source_text_original: Official contract text is available at the linked War.gov source.

events.title: Ground Based Strategic Deterrent consolidated maintenance facility construction contract
events.summary: Federal Contracting Inc. received a $143.18 million action for design-bid-build construction of a consolidated maintenance facility supporting the Ground Based Strategic Deterrent program at Cheyenne, Wyoming.

programs.name_zh: LGM-35A Sentinel 哨兵洲際彈道飛彈

action.description: Design-bid-build construction of a consolidated maintenance facility for the Ground Based Strategic Deterrent program.
action.description_zh: 在懷俄明州 Cheyenne 建造 Ground Based Strategic Deterrent 計畫的整合維修設施，支援新一代陸基核威懾／LGM-35A Sentinel 洲際彈道飛彈體系。

events.title_zh: Federal Contracting 獲 1.432 億美元 Sentinel／GBSD 維修設施工程合約
events.summary_zh: Federal Contracting Inc. 獲得 1.432 億美元合約行動，在懷俄明州 Cheyenne 建造 Ground Based Strategic Deterrent 整合維修設施，合約累計面額為 1.483 億美元，預計 2029 年底完成。GBSD 即後續發展為 LGM-35A Sentinel 的美國新一代陸基核威懾計畫。該承包商為私人公司，無公開 ticker。
events.source_text_original: Official contract text is available at the linked War.gov source.
